top_news.title: JD.com Unit Agrees to Pay SEC $500,000 Over ‘Sham Transactions’
top_news.summary: A unit of China’s online retailer JD.com Inc. agreed to pay $500,000 to settle US Securities and Exchange Commission claims it made a series of “sham transactions” to meet revenue targets for several quarters starting in October 2022.

top_news.title: Bond Trader Whose Wrong-Way Bets Collapsed Firm Gets 16 Years
top_news.summary: A former trader at IFS Securities Inc. was ordered to serve more than 16 years in prison for unauthorized bond trades in 2019 that led to $30 million in losses and bankrupted the Chicago broker-dealer.

top_news.title: KKR Wraps Up $2.1 Billion Leveraged Loan for Integer Acquisition
top_news.summary: KKR & Co. Inc. finalized a $2.1 billion loan to help fund its pending acquisition of medical-device maker Integer Holdings Corp. after securing more-favorable terms, seizing on investor demand for leveraged-buyout financings.

top_news.title: Oraclum Hedge Fund Founder Charged With Lying About Returns
top_news.summary: Vuk Vukovic, a founder of New York hedge fund Oraclum Capital LLC, was charged by federal prosecutors with lying to investors about his fund’s performance.

top_news.title: Finding Stability in Investing: Masters in Business with Seth Bernstein
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with Seth Bernstein, Chief Executive Officer of AllianceBernstein. They discuss his tenure at JPMorgan Chase where he was managing director and global head of Managed Solutions & Strategy at J.P. Morgan Asset Management. They discuss understanding the Private Credit industry and the future of Mutual Funds as ETFs become the future of investing. Seth also discusses the importance of in-person collaboration as well as how to invest for retirement.  (Source: Bloomberg)
